entities.name: Michaił Orda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikhail Sergeyevich Orda is a Belarusian trade unionist and politician. He has been a member of the House of Representatives since 2024, having previously served from 2000 to 2012. From 2014 to 2024, he served as chairman of the Federation of Trade Unions. From 2016 to 2019, he was a member of the Council of the Republic. From 2003 to 2006, he served as first secretary of the Belarusian Republican Youth Union.

entities.summary: Mikhail Sergeyevich Orda is a Belarusian trade unionist and politician. He has been a member of the House of Representatives since 2024, having previously served from 2000 to 2012. From 2014 to 2024, he served as chairman of the Federation of Trade Unions. From 2016 to 2019, he was a member of the Council of the Republic. From 2003 to 2006, he served as first secretary of the Belarusian Republican Youth Union.
